scores.evidence: Phase 1: Foundation ... GitHub API integration, Basic issue parsing, WebHook setup; Phase 2: LLM-based analysis
scores.rationale: Phases go roughly foundation to intelligence to resolution, but guardrails and knowledge base are not proven before dependent work, and ordering is loose.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1-2) - GitHub API integration, WebHook setup, Simple classification (bug/feature/question)
scores.rationale: Phase 1 is a thin ingest-and-classify slice, but it is not stated to be an end-to-end production path with an action and deployment.
No irreversible decisions are listed with defaults and flip conditions; choices such as Claude, Postgres and cloud are just assumed.
No ordering of work by blast radius within phases.

scores.evidence: Flag complex security issues for review; Don't merge code without tests
scores.rationale: Security guardrails exist only in a standalone section and config, and are not threaded through the phases.

scores.evidence: Monitoring & Metrics - False positive rate (incorrectly closed), Resolution time, Cost per resolution
scores.rationale: Metrics are listed in a standalone section, but not in Phase 1 and not tied to any phase until a late analytics dashboard.

scores.evidence: Docker containers; GitHub Actions for CI/CD
scores.rationale: Only tool names appear, with no reproducibility practice for builds, data, prompts or environments.

scores.evidence: API rate limits | Medium | Queue management, caching, batching
scores.rationale: Failure handling appears only in the risks table and is not threaded through the phases.

scores.evidence: Auto-Close: >90% confidence; Human Review: <70% confidence; Phase 3 Auto-Resolution
scores.rationale: Confidence thresholds and human approval exist, but they are not sequenced before capabilities. There are no budgets, and the knowledge base, LLM analysis and feedback are not cleanly ordered.

scores.evidence: Phase 4: Advanced Features ... Multi-language support; Optional: Redis, Vector DB
scores.rationale: Later features and optional items are listed, but no pull-forward conditions are given.

note: A generic feature-oriented plan with some guardrails and metrics, but it lacks decision gates, is not organized around a walking skeleton, has no threaded security, observability or resilience, and does not sequence AI defenses first.
